Abstract: Judging whether a model response is harmful requires contextual and normative choices, yet red-teaming studies often delegate this judgment to automated evaluators. items.title: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
items.excerpt:
arXiv:2611.28202v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multimodal foundation models can play video games well when the game waits for them, but often fail when it keeps running. We find that much of this gap lies in the harness, which decides what the model sees, what it remembers, and how its outputs become actions over time.
